notes: Derived edit (very_likely): the largest city on Java becomes Medan. Modelled on the Honshu template: has_largest_city gives a stored neighbour on the new value (Medan is the largest city on Sumatra) that is overturned in every world. Derivability very_likely: the premises (Jakarta is Indonesia's largest city and is on Java) are everywhere, the island-level statement is rare ('largest city on Java' 32; 'Jakarta is the largest city on Java' 0). Derived: binding (premise route), subproperty (Medan and Surabaya on the same island), composition (Istiqlal Mosque), plus one derived-beliefs query (the largest city in Indonesia). Related: whether Medan is the largest city on Sumatra, via the subproperty step with the revision fact that a city lies on only one island. Worlds: Jakarta leaves Java (w1) or stops being Indonesia's largest city (w2), kept unweighted; under w1 the indeterminate query keeps Jakarta, so a model that never propagated the edit also matches w1. Gaps: the Rule 6 audit of the Bandung, Surabaya and Istiqlal questions has not been run.
